Variants.Content: Alan riders depend on mounts, remounts and grazing. Long weapons and riding skills still need rested horses; distant pursuit strains return routes, camp protection and food together.

Alan cavalry depends on mounts, remounts and grazing. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Pursuit lengthens returns and increases wagon-guard burdens.

Pursuit lengthens returns and increases wagon-guard burdens. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Alan cavalry depends on mounts, remounts and grazing.
